key: cognite|senior product manager generative ai and ai ml
title: Senior Product Manager Generative AI and AI/ML
jd_excerpt:
Position Overview

Join Cognite as a Senior Product Manager focused on Generative AI and AI/ML. In this role, you will help define innovative product strategies, drive rapid prototyping, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver transformative industrial AI products. Be a part of a dynamic, mission‐driven team at a global SaaS leader reshaping digital transformation across multiple industries.

Key Responsibilities

• Gain feedback from customers to ensure a focused approach in building our products.

• Drive rapid prototyping of our Generative AI use cases to validate innovative ideas.

• Identify where internal and external experts face limits, shaping our product roadmap to address these challenges.

• Collaborate with stakeholders and executives to ensure successful product launches.

• Partner with customer teams to enable the adoption of our Generative AI solutions.

• Drive product strategy, setting priorities alongside Design, Engineering, and Technical Program Management teams.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math or a related field.

• Experience owning and driving roadmap strategy and product definition.

• Proven track record with feature delivery and managing tradeoffs.

• 7+ years of technical product or program management experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience collaborating directly with Engineers on product enhancements.

• Familiarity with product management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement.

• Proven ability in leading complex strategic and operational initiatives across multiple domains.

• Strong understanding of the AI/ML software stack and familiarity with frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Benefits & Perks

• Competitive Compensation including base plus bonus.

• 401(k) with 4% employer matching.

• Health, Dental, Vision & Disability Coverages with premiums fully covered for employees and dependents.

• Unlimited PTO with the flexibility to enjoy it.

• 18 Company Holidays, including the week between Christmas & New Years.

• Paid Parental Leave Program.

• Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) and Referral Program.

• In-office catered lunches 3x per week and fully stocked fridges.

• Join a diverse team of 70+ nationalities with a strong focus on DEI.

• Opportunity to work with and learn from top talent on ambitious projects.

• Access to our HUB for direct conversations with Cognite team members and partners.

• Paid mobile phone and WiFi.

• For pet lovers – get a chance to meet Spot!
